description: The watch list as Claude Code managed settings (allowedMcpServers, deniedMcpServers) and claude mcp add commands. `managed_settings` goes into a Claude Code managed settings source (see `docs`). `allowManagedMcpServersOnly` restricts user-added servers to this list. Checked servers rated as `risco` go to `deniedMcpServers`. The exact URL and that URL followed by `?*` permit the checked route with optional query parameters. Expired or unchecked items stay out. `comandos` has one quoted `claude mcp add` command per allowed server.
name: claude_code_allowlist
title: Claude Code allowlist
